class HostApp(App[None]):
    """Small app that hosts a fixed collection of widgets."""

    def __init__(self, *widgets: Widget) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._hosted_widgets = widgets

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield from self._hosted_widgets

def test_widget_subclass_name_and_focus_configuration() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(BadWidgetName, match="should be capitalized"):
        type("bad_widget", (Widget,), {})

    class Parent(Widget, can_focus=True, can_focus_children=False):
        pass

    class Inherits(Parent):
        pass

    class Overrides(Parent, can_focus=False, can_focus_children=True):
        pass

    assert (Parent.can_focus, Parent.can_focus_children) == (True, False)
    assert (Inherits.can_focus, Inherits.can_focus_children) == (True, False)

async def test_query_helpers_enforce_ids_and_exact_types() -> None:
    class CustomStatic(Static):
        pass

    app = HostApp(
        Box(
            Static("plain", id="plain"),
            CustomStatic("custom", id="custom"),
            Box(Label("nested", id="nested-label"), id="nested-box"),
        )
    )
    async with app.run_test(size=(30, 10)) as pilot:
        await pilot.pause()
        box = app.query_one(Box)
        plain = app.query_one("#plain")

        assert box.get_child_by_id("plain") is plain
        assert box.get_child_by_id("custom", Static) is custom

        with pytest.raises(WrongType, match="wrong type"):
            box.get_child_by_id("plain", Label)

        with pytest.raises(NoMatches, match="No child found"):
            box.get_child_by_id("missing")

        with pytest.raises(WrongType, match="wrong type"):

        assert box.get_child_by_type(Static) is plain
        assert box.get_child_by_type(CustomStatic) is custom
        with pytest.raises(NoMatches, match="No immediate child"):
            box.get_child_by_type(Label)


async def test_mount_supports_ordering_and_awaitable_forms() -> None:
    app = HostApp(Box(Label("zero", id="zero"), Label("one", id="one"), Label("two", id="two")))
    async with app.run_test(size=(30, 10)) as pilot:
        await pilot.pause()
        box = app.query_one(Box)

        await box.mount(Label("x", id="x"))
        assert [child.id for child in box.children] == ["zero", "one", "two", "x"]

        await box.mount(Label("before", id="before"), before="#two")
        assert [child.id for child in box.children] == [
            "zero",
            "one",
            "before",
            "two",
            "x",
        ]

        await box.mount(Label("after", id="after"), after=box.query_one("#zero"))
        assert [child.id for child in box.children] == [
            "zero",
            "after",
            "one",
            "before",
            "two",
            "x",
        ]

        await box.mount_all(
            (Label(str(index), id=f"many-{index}") for index in range(2)),
            before=1,
        )
        assert [child.id for child in box.children] == [
            "zero",
            "many-0",
            "many-1",
            "after",
            "one",
            "before",
            "two",
            "x",
        ]

        await_mount = box.mount(Label("called", id="called"))
        await await_mount()
        assert box.query_one("#called").is_mounted

async def test_compose_context_manager_mount_compose_and_recompose() -> None:
    class ComposedBox(Box):
        def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
            with Label("group", id="group"):
                yield Label("nested", id="nested")
            yield Label("end", id="end")

    app = HostApp(ComposedBox(id="box"))
    async with app.run_test(size=(30, 10)) as pilot:
        await pilot.pause()
        box = app.query_one(ComposedBox)

        assert [child.id for child in box.children] == ["group", "end"]
        assert box.query_one("#nested").parent is box.query_one("#group")

        def extra_widgets() -> ComposeResult:
            with Label("extra-group", id="extra-group"):
                yield Label("extra-child", id="extra-child")
            yield Label("extra-end", id="extra-end")

        await box.mount_compose(extra_widgets())
        assert [child.id for child in box.children] == [
            "group",
            "end",
            "extra-group",
            "extra-end",
        ]

        box.refresh(recompose=True)
        await pilot.pause()
        assert [child.id for child in box.children] == ["group", "end"]

async def test_focus_blur_hover_and_disabled_state() -> None:
    app = HostApp(Box(Focusable(id="first"), Focusable(id="second"), id="parent"))
    async with app.run_test(size=(30, 20)) as pilot:
        await pilot.pause()
        parent = app.query_one(Box)
        first = app.query_one("#first", Focusable)
        second = app.query_one("#second", Focusable)

        first.styles.height = 1
        second.styles.height = 1
        await pilot.pause()

        first.focus()
        await pilot.pause()
        assert app.focused is first
        assert first.has_focus is True
        assert parent.has_focus_within is True
        assert first.get_pseudo_class_state() == PseudoClasses(
            enabled=True, focus=True, hover=False
        )

        await pilot.hover(first)
        await pilot.pause()
        assert first.mouse_hover is True
        assert first.is_mouse_over is True
        assert first.get_pseudo_class_state().hover is True

        await pilot.hover(second)
        await pilot.pause()
        assert first.mouse_hover is False
        assert second.mouse_hover is True

        first.blur()
        await pilot.pause()
        assert first.has_focus is False

        first.disabled = True
        await pilot.pause()
        assert first.is_disabled is True
        assert first.focusable is False
        assert first.get_pseudo_class_state().enabled is False

        parent.disabled = True
        await pilot.pause()
        assert second.is_disabled is True
        assert second.focusable is False

class CapturingWidget(Static):
    """Widget which records ``Print`` events sent to it."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__("capturing")
        self.print_events: list[events.Print] = []

    def on_print(self, event: events.Print) -> None:
        self.print_events.append(event)


async def test_begin_and_end_capture_print(monkeypatch):
    app = EmptyApp()
    sink = io.StringIO()
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "_original_stdout", sink)
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "_original_stderr", sink)
    async with app.run_test() as pilot:
        widget = CapturingWidget()
        await app.mount(widget)

        app.begin_capture_print(widget)
        print("captured stdout")
        print("captured stderr", file=sys.stderr)
        await pilot.pause()

        stdout_events = [
            event for event in widget.print_events if not event.stderr
        ]
        stderr_events = [event for event in widget.print_events if event.stderr]
        assert "captured stdout" in "".join(e.text for e in stdout_events)
        assert "captured stderr" in "".join(e.text for e in stderr_events)

        app.end_capture_print(widget)
        event_count = len(widget.print_events)
        print("not captured")
        await pilot.pause()
        assert len(widget.print_events) == event_count

def messages_of(messages: list[object], message_type: type) -> list[object]:
    """Return only the messages of the given type.

    A message may be delivered to more than one pump, so callers should assert
    on the *content* of a match rather than on the number of matches.
    """

    return [message for message in messages if isinstance(message, message_type)]

"""Behavioral tests for the public surface of ``textual.widgets._data_table``.

The tests exercise the DataTable widget through its public API, together with
the helper classes/functions that the file exposes (keys, ``Column`` and
``default_cell_formatter``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from rich.text import Text

from textual.app import App
from textual.coordinate import Coordinate
from textual.widgets import DataTable
from textual.widgets._data_table import default_cell_formatter
from textual.widgets.data_table import (
    CellDoesNotExist,
    CellKey,
    Column,
    ColumnDoesNotExist,
    ColumnKey,
    DuplicateKey,
    RowDoesNotExist,
    RowKey,
    StringKey,
)


class TableApp(App[None]):
    """A tiny app whose only widget is a DataTable."""

    def compose(self):
        yield DataTable()


def messages_of(messages: list[object], message_type: type) -> list[object]:
    """Return only the messages of the given type.

    A message may be delivered to more than one pump, so callers should assert
    on the *content* of a match rather than on the number of matches.
    """

    return [message for message in messages if isinstance(message, message_type)]

def test_string_key_behaves_like_its_string_value() -> None:
    key = StringKey("alpha")

    assert key.value == "alpha"
    assert key == "alpha"
    assert "alpha" == key
    assert key != "beta"
    assert hash(key) == hash("alpha")
    assert key == StringKey("alpha")
    assert key < "beta"
    assert key < StringKey("beta")
    assert key <= StringKey("alpha")
    assert list(key.__rich_repr__()) == [("value", "alpha")]


def test_anonymous_string_keys_are_unique() -> None:
    first = StringKey()
    second = StringKey()

    assert first.value is None
    assert second.value is None
    assert first is not second
    assert first != second
    # Keys without a string value hash by identity so that they stay unique.
    assert hash(first) == id(first)
    assert hash(second) == id(second)
    assert list(first.__rich_repr__()) == [("value", None)]


def test_row_and_column_keys_are_string_keys() -> None:
    row_key = RowKey("row")
    column_key = ColumnKey("column")

    assert isinstance(row_key, StringKey)
    assert isinstance(column_key, StringKey)
    assert row_key == "row"
    assert column_key == "column"
    # String keys compare by their wrapped value, regardless of subclass.
    assert RowKey("same") == ColumnKey("same")


def test_cell_key_exposes_row_and_column_keys() -> None:
    row_key = RowKey("row")
    column_key = ColumnKey("column")
    cell_key = CellKey(row_key, column_key)

    assert cell_key.row_key is row_key
    assert cell_key.column_key is column_key
    assert cell_key.row_key == "row"
    assert cell_key.column_key == "column"
    assert cell_key == (row_key, column_key)
    assert list(cell_key.__rich_repr__()) == [
        ("row_key", row_key),
        ("column_key", column_key),
    ]

async def test_result_callback_completes_future_and_schedules_callback() -> None:
    future: asyncio.Future[str] = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
    requester = ResultRequester()
    received: list[str] = []

    def callback(result: str | None) -> None:
        received.append(result or "")

    result_callback = ResultCallback(requester, callback, future)
    result_callback("payload")

    assert await future == "payload"
    assert requester.calls == [(callback, "payload")]
    assert received == []
    assert result_callback.callback is None

async def test_maximize_and_minimize_affect_classes_arrangement_and_focus() -> None:
    app = App()
    async with app.run_test(size=(40, 10)) as pilot:
        screen = MaxScreen()

        normal_ids = {widget.id for widget in screen.arrange(screen.size).widgets}
        assert normal_ids == {"keep", "normal", "holder", "f1", "always"}

        focus1 = screen.query_one("#f1", FocusProbe)
        assert screen.maximize(focus1) is True
        assert screen.maximized is focus1
        assert screen.has_class("-maximized-view")
        assert focus1.has_class("-maximized")

        maximized_ids = {widget.id for widget in screen.arrange(screen.size).widgets}
        assert maximized_ids == {"keep", "f1"}

        screen.set_focus(focus1)
        await pilot.pause()
        assert screen.focus_next() is focus1

        screen.minimize()
        await pilot.pause()
        assert screen.maximized is None
        assert screen.has_class("-maximized-view") is False
        assert focus1.has_class("-maximized") is False
        assert {
            widget.id for widget in screen.arrange(screen.size).widgets
        } == normal_ids

        screen.set_focus(focus1)
        await pilot.pause()
        screen.action_maximize()
        assert screen.maximized is focus1
        screen.action_minimize()
        assert screen.maximized is None

        nested = screen.query_one("#nested", FocusProbe)
        holder = screen.query_one("#holder", FocusHolder)

        assert screen.maximize(normal) is False
        assert screen.maximized is None

        assert screen.maximize(always) is True
        assert screen.maximized is always
        screen.minimize()

        # By default, maximize the nearest maximizeable ancestor.
        assert screen.maximize(nested) is True
        assert screen.maximized is holder
        assert holder.has_class("-maximized")
        screen.minimize()

        assert screen.maximize(nested, container=False) is True
        assert screen.maximized is nested
        assert nested.has_class("-maximized")

def test_soft_wrap_controls_wrap_width_and_virtual_size() -> None:
    import asyncio

    async def run() -> None:
        text = "0123456789" * 5 + "\nshort"
        async with mounted_editor(text, soft_wrap=True, show_line_numbers=False) as (
            _app,
            pilot,
            wrapped,
        ):
            await pilot.pause()
            assert wrapped.wrap_width > 0
            assert wrapped.virtual_size.height > wrapped.document.line_count

        async with mounted_editor(text, soft_wrap=False, show_line_numbers=False) as (
            _app,
            pilot,
            unwrapped,
        ):
            await pilot.pause()
            assert unwrapped.wrap_width == 0
            assert unwrapped.virtual_size.width >= 50
            assert unwrapped.virtual_size.height == 2

    asyncio.run(run())


def test_cursor_screen_offset_and_scrolling_into_view() -> None:
    import asyncio

    async def run() -> None:
        text = "\n".join(f"line {index}" for index in range(30))
        async with mounted_editor(text, show_line_numbers=True) as (_app, pilot, editor):
            await pilot.pause()
            editor.move_cursor((1, 2))
            await pilot.pause()
            assert editor.cursor_screen_offset.y == editor.content_region.y + 1

            editor.move_cursor((25, 0))
            await pilot.pause()
            assert editor.cursor_location == (25, 0)
            assert editor.scroll_offset.y > 0

    asyncio.run(run())
